newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Bauma issue fully underwritten.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Bauma issue fully underwritten.

text.p: Poland's Bauma SA paving-stone maker signed agreements with six companies for the underwriting of its issue of 1.2 million new shares, on subscription from January 16 to 24, Bauma said in a Monday statement.

Bauma said that Polish Private Equity 1 and Polish Private Equity 2 are to take over 300,000 shares each, Investment House BWE SA and Bank Wschodnio-Europejski SA 200,000 shares each and BRE brokerage and Bank Ochrony Srodowiska brokerage 100,000 shares each.
The issue price is 10 zlotys per share. The first two underwriters would pay 9.48 zlotys per share and the other four 9.3 zlotys per share.
Bauma's capital is now divided into 130,421 shares.
